home.title: Ceylon Serpents · Snakes of Sri Lanka field guide
home.description: A trilingual field guide to Sri Lanka's snakes in English, Sinhala and Tamil: species profiles, habitats, myths, a learning game and snakebite first aid.

library.title: Snake library: species of Sri Lanka
library.description: Browse Sri Lankan snakes by English, Sinhala, Tamil or scientific name. Filter by habitat, endemic status, group and medical importance.

identify.title: Identify a snake in Sri Lanka from a photo
identify.description: An experimental, non-diagnostic guide to compare a snake photo with Sri Lankan species. Learn the features, never a safe-or-dangerous verdict.

habitats.title: Snake habitats of Sri Lanka: zones and species
habitats.description: Explore Sri Lanka's wet, dry and intermediate zones and seven habitats, from Sinharaja rainforest to paddy fields, and the snakes found in each.

knowledge.title: Knowledge corner: snake behaviour, myths and folklore
knowledge.description: How snakes move and behave, Sri Lankan snake folklore and stories, and myths checked against the evidence.

play.title: Snakes and ladders: learn Sri Lanka's snakes
play.description: A free snakes and ladders game for 1 to 4 players. Every snake is a real Sri Lankan species with a quiz, and every ladder is a snake-safety habit.

safety.title: Snakebite first aid in Sri Lanka · Call 1990
safety.description: What to do and what not to do after a snakebite in Sri Lanka. Keep still, remove rings, call 1990 for a free ambulance or go straight to hospital.

sources.title: About Ceylon Serpents: sources and credits
sources.description: How Ceylon Serpents was compiled: references, image credits, content review process and known limitations.

compare.title: Compare snake species
compare.description: Compare up to three Sri Lankan snake species side by side, with the reasons appearance can mislead.
